intro: We built Upmods Eudora to hold what your wardrobe can’t. Eudora’s deep underbed storage and wide headboard make it easier to rest well — and organising — beautifully simple.

features.title: Built to be solid, designed to be seen
features.text: Crafted from engineered wood, our bed combines sturdy support with clean design — so it feels as good as it looks, day after day.

features.title: Headboard comfort that makes a statement
features.text: The wide rectangular headboard adds structure and presence to your room, while offering you comfortable back support whenever you need a quiet moment.

features.title: Box storage that simplifies your life
features.text: The box-style underbed compartments offer easy access to the things that matter. It’s smart storage that helps you make the most of your space, effortlessly. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: Calm, grounded, and thoughtfully made
features.text: Our rich cinnamon-toned finish brings warmth and depth to your space — designed to make your bedroom feel relaxed, welcoming, and uniquely yours.

features.title: Protection that keeps up with you
features.text: The PU coating adds a durable, scratch-resistant layer to your bed’s surface — helping it stay beautiful, even through life’s little bumps.

name: Upmods Eudora King Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
